scope: Static API inventory and manually reviewed Ascend candidate families; candidate is not equivalence or execution evidence.

fia.scope: Prefill/decode inference and sink-related parameters; exact target and parameter constraints require version-specific validation.

fa.scope: Training attention; this documented version marks Ascend950 unsupported, so it is not a current-machine support claim.

transformer.scope: Transformer operator catalog; names are candidates only, not proof of Ascend950 or full API equivalence.

grouped_mm.scope: Page also describes GroupedMatmulV5 and migration; supports grouping and selected quantization modes, not arbitrary CUDA layouts.

quant_mm.scope: Quantized matmul; deprecation note points to V5. Also distinguishes Mm and BatchMatMul. NVIDIA FP4 scale layouts are not implied.

nn.scope: NN catalog including norm, activation, quantization, sampling and fusion variants. Product support is per row and per version.

rope.scope: Rotary embedding modes and product-specific restrictions; does not implement every upstream position/scale construction.

merge.scope: Merge local attention outputs and LSE; log-base and layouts require adapters.

kv.scope: Slot-mapped KV update; metadata conversion and physical cache layout remain separate.

moe.scope: Token permutation; does not by itself implement a complete fused MoE/EP API.

hccl.scope: AllReduce/AllGather/ReduceScatter/AlltoAll and related collectives. CUDA IPC/NVSHMEM/MNNVL resource protocols are not interchangeable.

rgdr.scope: Recurrent gated delta rule including g/gk descriptions; Ascend950 is listed. Not a verification of upstream chunk, checkpoint, MTP or state-pool contracts.

rgdr_old.scope: Older version marks Ascend950 unsupported; retained to show why versions cannot be mixed.

fla_npu.scope: Announces flash-linear-attention-npu/GDN work. Not a pinned callable API or local execution result.

versions.scope: Deprecation/migration of FIA, GroupedMatmul and MLA interfaces; not a mandate to change this repository's frozen ABI.

gemma_old.scope: Older product table marks Ascend950 unsupported. Current TorchNPU execution evidence must remain separate from this document.

sampling_old.scope: Sampling pipeline and restrictions; older product table marks Ascend950 unsupported. Current API lowering/version has not been traced here.

attention.single.gap: Q/KV layout, mask convention, LSE base, dtype, scales and version must match; direct public function does not need an explicit wrapper.

attention.batch.gap: Batch plan/scheduler, persistent workspace and repeated run are wrapper responsibilities; a loop of per-request FIA is not the upstream fused scheduler.

attention.mixed.gap: Local BatchAttention is Host/framework only by default; the named API is not connected to the ordinary production CANN batch runner.

attention.sparse.gap: Block CSR, variable blocks, sparse index meanings, Q/KV dimensions and training/inference APIs differ; local sparse facade is absent.

attention.mla.candidate: MLA prolog, FIA/MLA inference and sparse attention components
attention.mla.gap: Compressed KV, RoPE split, cache/scale layouts and reusable plan require a dedicated implementation; local MLA module is absent.

attention.specialized.candidate: FIA components; specialized scheduler or kernel required
attention.specialized.gap: POD, sinks, prefix sharing, DCP, prepared decode and hardware-specific paths are not covered merely by single prefill/decode.

attention.merge.gap: Two-input, multi-input and in-place public forms remain distinct; LSE base/layout adapters are required.

gemm.dense.gap: Transpose, broadcast, bias, output dtype and out semantics must be checked per interface.

gemm.grouped.gap: Segment wrapper is run-only; group list, zero-size groups, weight selection and physical layouts differ across APIs.

gemm.quantized.gap: FP8/MX/NVFP4 packing, scale type/granularity and weight preparation are independent contracts; local FP8 support is limited.

moe.fused.candidate: GroupedMatmul plus permutation, activation and reduction
moe.fused.gap: Local three MoE APIs have limited single-device implementations; upstream backend/activation/quantization variants are not all interchangeable.

moe.ep.gap: Local ep_size>1 branch requires external cann_ops_transformer; no verified multi-rank execution or complete upstream moe_ep API family.

norm.gap: Five local APIs are limited; Gemma fused add uses Triton. Quantized/gated/model fusions need separate implementation and version checks.

norm.fused.gap: QK norm+RoPE, gate/residual, DiT and quantized outputs are additional semantics; basic RMSNorm support is insufficient.

rope.gap: Local six APIs share rotation components; Llama3.1 frequency scaling and QK fused variants are separate gaps.

sampling.gap: Local filtering, categorical sampling and speculative-chain logic compose several steps. RNG identity, ties and bit-exact cross-platform output are not claimed.

topk.candidate: Topk/Sort plus segment or page-table transforms
topk.gap: Variable-length, tie policy, logits/index layouts and page-table transforms are not a single generic topk equivalence; no local public topk family.

kv.gap: Local ordinary paged append exists; MLA append, metadata helpers and packed FP4 append are missing public operations.

quantization.candidate: DynamicQuant / DynamicMxQuant / cast and layout components
quantization.gap: Local QuantSpec is a contract, not a quantization kernel family. CUDA swizzled scales, NVFP4/MX layouts and rounding require explicit conversion and verification.

quantization.bits.gap: Packbits/segment packbits bit order and offsets are not DynamicQuant semantics; no local public kernels.

activation.candidate: SwiGlu / GeluMul and NN activation families
activation.gap: Local three basic gated activations exist; quantized/expert-packed/backward variants are separate interfaces.

linear.gdn.candidate: RecurrentGatedDeltaRule; FLA-NPU ecosystem for chunk pipelines
linear.gdn.gap: Recurrent versus chunk, initial/final state, MTP acceptance and checkpoints need alignment; no local GDN family.

linear.kda.candidate: RecurrentGatedDeltaRule gk-related formulation or dedicated implementation
linear.kda.gap: Per-channel gates, state orientation, packed decode and prefill checkpoint contracts are unverified; no local KDA family.

linear.gdp.gap: Gated delta product is not established equivalent to gated delta rule; no local GDP family.

ssm.mamba.gap: Causal Conv1D, selective state update and SSD combined pipelines need separate state semantics; no local Mamba family.

communication.gap: Math collectives can be reimplemented; CUDA IPC/NVLink/MNNVL/NVSHMEM handles, symmetric memory and fused protocols are vendor-specific. No local comm facade.

training.candidate: Grad operators plus explicit graph/autograd integration
training.gap: Presence of inference forward or one Grad operator does not provide upstream training, auxiliary output or autograd contracts.

model.specialized.candidate: Matmul/norm/RoPE/attention components; dedicated pipeline review required
model.specialized.gap: Model-specific MiniMax/Kimi/Qwen/mHC/MSA/vision/LoRA pipelines are not implemented by naming similar basic operators.

logits.gap: Grammar/logits processing state and compiled processor protocols need their own integration; no local logits_processor family.

infrastructure.gap: Do not count enums, configurations, compiler factories, workspace queries or trace helpers as accelerated operators.
